seniors.seated_version: Upper body lead-and-follow exercises while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Reduced tempo, focus on weight transfer without complex turns.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo, limited range of motion.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms kept slightly tense to facilitate lead-and-follow communication.
movement_profile.footwork: Leader: left on 1/3, right on 2/4. Follower: steps on every beat.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: No jumps or acrobatic moves allowed.
movement_profile.partnering: Lead and follow based on physical contact and visual cues.

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic variation allowed as a 'break'.
signature_moves.name: Kick Ball Change

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic variation allowed as a 'break'.
signature_moves.name: Ronde Ball Change

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Acrobatic moves, lifts, and full spins (spins are restricted).

music_profile.musical_form: Popular music from the swing family
music_profile.sound_description: Upbeat pop music in 4/4 time suitable for swing-style movement.

basic_steps: Leader: Step left on beat 1 or 3, step right on beat 2 or 4.
Follower: Step on every beat, left foot on 2 and 4, right foot on 1 and 3.
teaching.formation: Partner dance, moving counter-clockwise around the room.
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on maintaining arm tension and responding to the leader's cues.
